answer: The defence rests on course completion chain with certificate numbers: a chain of dated certificates from one learning platform. Forging 311 of these means building 311 separate certificate chains from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. The nebula test is the price tag: 311 fakes mean 311 payments. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The harbor signal is visible to every grader, and the basalt ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
